_meta.name: Bridgestone claims library + guardrail rules (Epic 3)
_meta.aligned_to: Official agreed plan: Epic 3 stories 3.1-3.6; Compliance & Guardrails Agent checks Audience Rules, Claims, Offers, Business Rules
_meta.status: SYNTHETIC / PLACEHOLDER. Not real Bridgestone substantiation, product or legal data. Confirm with the account team before presenting any of it as real.
how_the_agent_uses_it: 1. Claim extraction (story 3.4): detect claims in the copy using each claim's prohibited_wording + each rule's detect patterns; assign claim_type.
2. Check (stories 3.2, 3.3): for each detected claim, apply the rules for its claim_type. A claim needing evidence passes only if its evidence_id resolves to valid evidence.
3. Also check audience_rules, offer_rules and business_rules against the brief / audience / offer.
4. Return PASS, or VETO + constraints (see verdict_schema). Compliance NEVER writes replacement copy (story 3.5); the Campaign Agent rewrites using the constraints and allowed_wording.
5. Anything not covered by the library or rules = ESCALATE, never a silent pass.
_meta.coworker_mapping: Each rule/claim lists its Coworker Brand guardrail (Experience Context > Bridgestone > Claim Guardrails). 'existing' = created by the team; 'to_create' = paste from 'Claim Guardrails - paste.md'. Guardrail IDs marked to_create are suggested slugs; replace with the IDs Coworker assigns. This registry is the master copy.

Germany's situational winter-tyre requirement, as general road-law information

allowed_wording.de: In Deutschland gilt bei winterlichen Straßenverhältnissen die situative Winterreifenpflicht.

prohibited_wording.de: Ohne unsere Reifen drohen Ihnen Bußgelder

rules.name: comparative_claim_requires_evidence
rules.test: evidence_id resolves AND evidence is current AND names the compared competitor
rules.constraint: No unsupported comparative claims. Remove the competitor comparison or cite dated, verifiable price evidence.
rules.basis: EU comparative advertising rules (Directive 2006/114/EC); German UWG §6. PLACEHOLDER: legal to confirm.

rules.name: superiority_claim_requires_evidence
rules.test: evidence_id resolves to an independent test or award
rules.constraint: Superiority claims (best / safest / number 1) need cited independent evidence. Use descriptive wording instead.

rules.name: numeric_performance_requires_citation
rules.test: evidence_id resolves to a test with conditions stated
rules.constraint: Numeric performance figures need a cited test (who, when, conditions, tyre size).

rules.name: safety_outcome_escalates
rules.constraint: Safety outcome claims must be reviewed by legal.

rules.name: unknown_claim_escalates
rules.test: claim not matched by any claims_library entry or rule
rules.constraint: Unrecognised claim: route to a human reviewer.

rules.name: no_guaranteed_safety
rules.constraint: No claims implying guaranteed safety. Use e.g. 'Designed for winter driving conditions', 'Supports confident driving', 'Engineered for enhanced traction'.

rules.name: approved_tagline_only
rules.constraint: Use only the approved tagline 'Solutions for your journey'. 'Your Journey, Our Passion' is outdated.

rules.name: trademark_on_first_mention
rules.test: Bridgestone / Firestone product names (e.g. Potenza, Turanza, Ecopia, Blizzak) carry ® on first mention in each language version
rules.constraint: Add ® to the product name on first mention (e.g. Blizzak®).

offer_rules.name: offer_terms_stated
offer_rules.test: copy states validity date AND participating dealers
offer_rules.constraint: Offers must state the validity date and 'at participating dealers'.

offer_rules.name: max_discount
offer_rules.constraint: Maximum discount for reactive campaigns is 15% (PLACEHOLDER business limit).

audience_rules.name: email_consent_required
audience_rules.test: audience definition requires marketingConsent = true AND emailOptIn = true (email channel)
audience_rules.constraint: Email audiences must be consent-gated: marketingConsent AND emailOptIn.

audience_rules.name: push_consent_required
audience_rules.test: if channel = push: marketingConsent = true AND pushOptIn = true
audience_rules.constraint: Push audiences need marketingConsent AND pushOptIn.

audience_rules.name: market_scope
audience_rules.test: all profiles in the audience have country = 'Germany' (Demo 1 scope)
audience_rules.constraint: Audience must be limited to the campaign market (Germany).

business_rules.name: market_language
business_rules.test: Germany copy is in German (de-DE); English translation attached for review
business_rules.constraint: German market copy must be in German.

business_rules.name: season_matches_product
business_rules.test: winter / snow claims only for products with tyreSeason Winter or All-Season (EV-01)
business_rules.constraint: Winter claims only for winter or all-season products.

arbitration_protocol.compliance_returns: PASS, or VETO + constraints. Never replacement copy.
arbitration_protocol.campaign_agent_on_veto: Rewrites using the constraints and the claims_library allowed_wording, then resubmits (story 2.4)
arbitration_protocol.on_round_3_fail: ESCALATE: 'Escalated to Human' with all constraints and round history attached (story 3.6)
arbitration_protocol.on_escalate_rule: Safety-outcome or unlisted claims escalate immediately, without using up rounds

constraints.evidence_required: evidence type needed to allow the original claim, or null

verdict_schema.no_rewrite_field: Intentionally absent. Compliance does not write copy.
